messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — prototyping a "cost corridor" widget that shows token-level cost vs cache-savings per session. Want quick feedback on metrics we should surface.

Jordan Patel: Love that. Must have per-model (sku) breakdown + sticky-routing multiplier. Also need prefetch credit attribution across multi-model chains.

Maya Rivera: Agreed. Sessionized view is key: aggregate by session_id, show amortized cache credits and per-model token burn. Sampling at 1% for large orgs, full for anomalies.

Sam O'Neill: Quick Q — how do we avoid double-counting cache savings when a single request touches multiple models? Ledger currently credits first hotpath.

Alex Chen: Proposed UX: surface both "claimed" and "shared" savings. Claimed = ledger. Shared = prorate by token-contribution across models. Toggle in UI.

Lina Gomez: UI suggestion: inline toggle (Claimed / Shared / Effective) + small "what-if" slider to simulate routing changes and show delta in $$ and latency.

Jordan Patel: Backend requirements: per-invocation KV metadata: session_id, model_sku, cache_hit_bytes, token_counts, routing_tag. Can we piggyback on request envelope? low overhead.

Maya Rivera: Sampling plan: 1% sample stores full KV; use stratified amplification. For anomalies, trigger on-demand replay from WAL to compute exact attribution.

Sam O'Neill: Also add guardrail — don't surface negative amortized savings to tenant console unless confidence > 0.9. Customer-facing numbers need stability. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Note: created ticket INF-7421 to track implementation and API fields.

Alex Chen: Thanks all — I'll mock the panel and share a quick Figma + API spec tomorrow. :sparkles:
